title: Browser extension causing pop-ups
symptom: Pop-ups and a changed homepage appear in the browser
user_description: Ads keep popping up and my homepage has changed to something I've never seen. Did I get a virus?

options.text: Install the 'cleaner' that one of the pop-ups recommends
options.why: Fake cleaners in pop-ups are a common way to spread malware. Never follow instructions from the pop-up.

options.text: Tell her to keep clicking Allow on the pop-ups until they stop
options.why: Clicking Allow can grant more permissions to a harmful extension and make things worse.

options.text: Review the browser's extensions, remove any unknown or unapproved ones, reset the browser settings if needed, and run a security scan
options.why: Unwanted extensions are a common cause of pop-ups and changed settings. Removing them, resetting the browser and scanning checks for deeper problems.
Drastic. Pop-ups from a browser are usually fixed by removing the extension.

hints: What changed in the browser recently?
Where can you see everything added to the browser?
How can you check nothing deeper is wrong?
real_world_tip: Ask what she installed or clicked just before it started. It usually leads straight to the cause.
